description: Manage HighLevel funnels, websites, domains, workflows, and sub-accounts from your AI assistant. Check forms for spam, set up call screening, and compare account settings. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.2 — October 28, 2026. Clearer descriptions, example prompts, and setup checks. Existing connections and features are unchanged. Update your plugin or skill to load the revised instructions.

review.commerce_description: HighLevel Agency & Builder MCP provides MCP tool execution and structured output. It does not process direct in-chat payments.

negative.prompt: Book a roundtrip flight from New York to London for next week.
Transfer $500 from my checking account to my savings account immediately.
Add a dentist appointment to my personal Google Calendar for 3 PM tomorrow.

positive.description: Compare sub-account settings with a snapshot
positive.expected_behavior: Compares the live client sub-account against the agency Master Snapshot and lists any missing custom fields, tags, or workflow drift.
positive.prompt: Compare our client sub-account with our Master Snapshot and show differences in custom fields or workflows.

positive.description: Update a checkout page while keeping its order form
positive.expected_behavior: Exports the funnel checkout page layout, updates headline copy and CSS, and publishes while preserving native 2-step order forms, order bumps, and 1-click upsells.
positive.prompt: Update the headline and CSS on our checkout page, then publish it. Keep the two-step order form and one-click upsell working.

positive.description: Connect a branded domain and set up call screening
positive.expected_behavior: Plans and verifies client funnel and branded-link CNAME records, checks SSL readiness, and provisions a call-screening IVR workflow on the tracking number.
positive.prompt: Check our client's branded-link CNAME record and set up a call-screening menu on their tracking number.

positive.expected_behavior: Compiles and publishes a multi-step lead capture form with conditional branching, mapped custom fields, and custom styling.
positive.prompt: Create a 3-step lead qualification form with conditional logic and map its fields to our sub-account custom fields.

positive.description: Check account access and connection health
positive.expected_behavior: Audits sub-account API token health, verifies explicit context routing between sandbox and production, and reports readiness.
positive.prompt: Run a health check across our agency sub-accounts and verify API token and domain SSL status.
